notes.title: Demo update.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43947117/d62c87b40366bf028d1bafc47b5f49806ec27f85.gif[/img]
Progress on the game is moving steadily and we've added more features that will echo through out the entire game, including the starting area. 
You can try all of these updates in the Demo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43947117/41b7bb514d348888a231185d85914a6bd3d6e958.png[/img]
Find hidden collectible figurines scattered all around the area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43947117/48ce73079545596680230f5fbaa243bd5f98d090.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43947117/f2d0ffcaaf38fe194f85b9121945f1ce13b58d49.png[/img]
Defeat other opponents in adventure mode to unlock a variety of fighters for the versus mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43947117/ba6e5ddbfc557d21016218aa8aa7602e2a83292f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43947117/ca3cb7bc59b338ace7a39f4c012cc7fd5d61bafd.png[/img]
Break stuff, and interact with virtually anything, including Mocking cameras, and drink milkshakes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43947117/94824af79cc0f18dc988436b05841097c8cc9710.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43947117/75455d44c9f2f92965d90665681111830d9d499e.png[/img]
We updated resolutions, and introduced new animations while making sure that all assets are crisp on 4K monitors
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43947117/9f086bc59e46772d9fa4ca4ca2333e3d2568ba02.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43947117/f622125839015d310b27ff8e7ccdc07f46a1e79b.png[/img]
Challenge yourself and complete all achievements.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43947117/30a2915c3df063abf40ed9bb790416a7819f37df.png[/img]


We are always looking for ways to improve the game and make it more fun for you. We welcome suggestions from players, so feel free to share your feedback directly in-game or on our Discord channel.

Finally, here's a quick sneak peek at what's next 🤫
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43947117/e50c358dd8f0fdf7271224db3fc2ad5bb5d98afb.gif[/img]
